# Power Rush (The Rush Performance)

> Power Rush is a single-serve caffeine drink mix sold in sachets. Tear one sachet, mix it with a glass of water, and drink it. Each serving has 125 mg of caffeine. It is made for everyday moments like the 3 PM office slump, study sessions, long workdays, travel and long screen time, not for workouts. The main audience is students and working young adults aged 18 to 30.

Key facts:
- Format: single-serve powder sachet, mixed with 200 to 250 ml of water
- Caffeine: 125 mg per serving; the pack lists the serving guidance
- Flavours: Orange, Lemon, Strawberry, Mango (Orange and Lemon are available first; the others are listed as coming soon with a notify option)
- Brand: The Rush Performance, sold as Power Rush
- Safety note: contains caffeine. Not recommended for children, pregnant or breastfeeding women, or people sensitive to caffeine. Do not exceed the serving on the pack.
